name: aventuro
description: Find places to visit and read place cards with travel descriptions and photo credits.

interface.longDescription:
Aventuro helps you find places to visit and decide which ones fit your trip. Search sights, museums, parks, beaches and nature spots by city, region or place name, and narrow the results for family trips with kids, parking, indoor or outdoor settings, accessibility and similar needs.

Open a place card to read a travel description, the best time to visit, a typical visit time, practical tips, facilities, and a verified photo with its credit and a link to the full page on aventuro.io.

What it is good for: planning a day out, comparing a few places in a destination, and finding options for families, quiet half-days or short stops.

Limitations: Aventuro is read-only and has no accounts. It does not book tickets, hotels or transport, and it does not show live opening hours, weather, prices, queues or directions. Coverage depends on the places in the Aventuro catalog, so some destinations may return few or no results. Always check the official source for opening hours and tickets before you go.
defaultPrompt: What are good things to do with kids near Valencia?
Plan a quiet half-day in Lisbon with museums and parks.
Which beaches near Barcelona are good for a short visit?

positive.description: Family search with a parking filter
positive.prompt: What are the best things to do with kids near Valencia? Only places with free parking.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short list of places in the Valencia area that are good for kids and have free parking, for example the City of Arts and Sciences, Oceanogràfic and Bioparc, each with a link to its page on aventuro.io.

positive.prompt: Plan a quiet half-day in Lisbon: museums and parks.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns calm museums and parks in Lisbon, such as the Calouste Gulbenkian Museum, the Museu Nacional do Azulejo and Estufa Fria, and suggests a simple half-day order without inventing opening hours.

positive.description: Category search in a coastal city
positive.prompt: Beaches near Barcelona that are good for a short visit.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns beaches around Barcelona, such as Barceloneta Beach, Bogatell and San Sebastian, with the category and a link to each place page.

positive.description: Search, then read a place card
positive.prompt: Tell me about the Old Fortress in Corfu: best time to go and how long it takes.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Old Fortress in Corfu, opens its place card, and answers with the best time to visit and the typical visit time from the card, with a link to the aventuro.io page and no invented details.
Reports that no matching places were found and suggests trying a nearby city or a broader search, without making up places.

negative.prompt: Book me a hotel for next weekend.
What will the weather be like tomorrow, and will it rain this evening?
Delete my Aventuro account and change my password.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: place search with filters for family trips, parking and setting, and full place cards.
